title: Chapter 396 The Direction From Which The Monster Came
content:
Chapter 396 The Direction From Which The Monster Came

If Wang Shuo saw this situation, he would definitely sigh that it is better to be a tool man!

There are not too many emotions, and there is no fear.

Compared with the fierce battle between Wang Shuo and the monsters, the battle between the Black Dragon King and the monsters was equally fierce, but the results were much better.

Jin Guozhu and his men were faintly showing a tendency to be unable to hold on.

On Zhao Bangde's side, the battle situation was still unclear, and Apache was fighting Zhao Bangde head-on.

Wang Shuo's side was also in a bitter battle.

At this time, he was covered in blood and his eyes were red.

The three-headed dog of hell had been collected by him, and the reserve troops under the city wall rushed up. The city wall was like a meat grinder, constantly harvesting lives.

Under the pressure of death, there were constant breakthroughs in the current realm of generals.

There were also constant deaths in battle.

Bu Lanlan, Fang Kai, Fang Daguang, one by one, high-level generals, fell on the city wall.

Even Baili Liang, the commander of the city defense army of Wana County, died!

Wang Shuo saw with his own eyes that Baili Liang was chopped off by a monster with one claw.

Wang Shuo's eyes were red and he went berserk.

Other generals saw their comrades bleeding and were also bloodthirsty.

Gong Ping, Gong Kai and Li Jianguo, three brothers, broke through to the ranks of top generals one after another.

Wang Shuo kicked away a golden boss in front of him and found that Ye Tianba and Lin Dabiao were beaten back by a general-level boss and vomited blood.

Wang Shuo immediately stepped forward to support and gave Lin Dabiao three drops of water of life.

This water of life has to be said to be the best item for replenishing life value. There is no other one. It restores life value quickly, unlike other elixirs, which have a slow recovery speed and a usage interval.

The battle lasted from morning to evening, and it was so fierce that the sky was dark.

Wang Shuo was actually exhausted a long time ago, but a belief supported him.

If he fell, there would be no general on this wall who could fight against the generals of the monsters.

The battle situation might collapse in a very short time.

Finally, with his last breath, Wang Shuo killed the last warrior on this section of the city wall.

He was finally able to take a breath.

Because there were no more monsters on the city wall within hundreds of meters around him.

After resting for a while, Wang Shuo had to drag his tired body, clean up the remaining troops, and continue to support the neighboring places.

At this time, Wang Shuo's water of life had been used up, and he no longer dared to use the life-for-life fighting method.

Wang Shuo brought several of his commanders with him. First, everyone worked together to fight against the warriors, and second, he didn't want them to be left alone, resulting in his inability to rescue.

Just after Wang Shuo flattened the section of the city wall defended by Wana County, Wang Shuo suddenly had a bold idea.

"Tianba, immediately summon all members of the Hell Knights, let's go down the city wall and clean it up."

If you can get into the belly of the monster at this time, you will definitely be able to greatly improve your momentum.

Maybe, it can also make the monster feel that they have been defeated.

After that, Wang Shuo asked the commanders to take out ropes, put them on the battlements, climb down the wall along the ropes, and gather under the city.

There were only a few beasts left under this section of the wall, and they were completely without wisdom.

In front of the top generals, there was no threat at all.

A large area was cleared out quickly.

Wang Shuo took the opportunity to release the three-headed dog of hell.

It cleared the beasts at a devastating speed.

After organizing the army under the city wall, Wang Shuo led a group of top generals and the Knights of Hell to go deep into the heart of the monster.

Wang Shuo was also full of curiosity about the direction from which the monster came.
